notes.title: Launch Day Patch Maintenance Has Begun!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506090/0ab20d99837d6ea33721e253bc25d580442a01d5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Servers are now temporarily offline as we roll out the Necrolyte patch to Steam. This update brings fresh content and improvements just in time for launch.[/p][p][/p][p]Maintenance may take up to two hours. Thanks for your patience![/p]

notes.title: Stormgate Launch Day Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcSuZiVUZnTl59BWiZNTWjI4W3Oy5nRPkCMb9D-wp2I04u2DJiIrPWwxk5Vl_g7BLckZ1FosHJrW7DnoymvxyEKHuw3DOryzB6WFEAGogGtKS6iseM57e0jwuvzhlTMputG4iINwA?key=CXiFUsDqdOYfE574oRvGBw"][/img][/p][p]Welcome to the launch of Stormgate: Campaign One - Ashes of Earth! 

This is our Necrolyte update, the biggest single update yet for Stormgate! [/p][p][/p][p]This release marks a major milestone as we exit Early Access and officially launch Stormgate on Steam with the full 12-mission Ashes of Earth Vanguard campaign, complete with new unlockable pets and 36 all-new Steam achievements. [/p][p][/p][p]We’re also introducing the first part of our revamped Celestial Armada faction, giving them a massive mechanical overhaul focused on streamlining complexity and improving playability. Plus, our brand-new Sigma Labs experimental hub debuts with the Terrain Editor Alpha, opening the doors to full community map-making and Custom Games support. [/p][p][/p][p]Competitive players can dive into a fresh ladder reset, and our progression system now tracks your factional growth across modes with new Player Card Nameplates. There's also new art, two wild new Challengers in Skirmish mode, bug fixes and a balance update for all factions. [/p][p][/p][p]Whether you're here for the story, the strategy, or the sandbox, this patch has something for every Stormgate commander.[/p][p][/p][h1]Patch Notes: [/h1][p][/p][h2][b]Campaign: [/b][/h2][p]The full Vanguard campaign is now available, featuring 12 story-driven missions. Each mission includes three Steam achievements, rewarding players for exploration, challenge, and mastery. For those who brave the campaign on Brutal difficulty, new unlockable pets await: Fuzzy Moth (Mission 6), Terror Byte (Mission 9), and Bobble BOB (Mission 12)—each a unique reward for overcoming the toughest fights Stormgate has to offer.[/p][list][*][p]Vanguard Chapter 2: “The Raging Storms”[/p][list][*][p]Mission 7: “Darkened Skies”[/p][/*][*][p]Mission 8: “Destroyer of Worlds”[/p][/*][*][p]Mission 9: “Dying Light”[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Vanguard Chapter 3: “The Twisting Fates”[/p][list][*][p]Mission 10: “Into Madness”[/p][/*][*][p]Mission 11: “Dead Reckoning”[/p][/*][*][p]Mission 12: “Edge of Eternity”[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Campaign Chapter Pets - Unlock each pet by completing the mission on Brutal difficulty: [/p][list][*][p]Mission 6 - Fuzzy Moth[/p][/*][*][p]Mission 9 - Terror Byte[/p][/*][*][p]Mission 12 - Bobble BOB[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfW055S-NXbaGe9DUArXIYzZkcMtEuyha8uf3ZWRRktiUkqtauRoT9pI4CWRndWgAyf9RMViGI9BSCW3k_D1z4EKg90t6COlB_wjNnCQQdrzYmr5QomtJGylqLdtOMdJp-lARFoKw?key=CXiFUsDqdOYfE574oRvGBw"][/img][/p][h2][b]Sigma Labs: [/b][/h2][p]Welcome to Sigma Labs, our experimental testing ground for features and modes that are still in development. Here, you’ll get early access to tools and content that aren’t fully polished, but are ready for community feedback. Currently, this area includes Co-op Missions, the Terrain Editor Alpha, and Custom Games. In the future, you may see even more modes appear here such as the much-anticipated Team Mayhem. [/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdlszIYIw8u04XXEGAqOu7tLNbd-4yl_NytIyl9vigQJZ8FxALsROtE2zT-aEk0oRoU6Heso19SnCiOOf6l3xGnmaosFnCcV-4WDDtxpaUxbI_siVyclGq9wQPwfIf2OzO_cD4czg?key=CXiFUsDqdOYfE574oRvGBw"][/img][/p][h3][b]Terrain Editor Alpha: [/b][/h3][p]The Terrain Editor Alpha is now open to everyone! You can jump in and start creating your own maps, share them with friends, and explore a growing library of custom experiences built by other players. Whether you're designing competitive arenas or wild experimental layouts, this is your space to get creative and bring your ideas to life.[/p][p][/p][p]We're calling this initial release the Terrain Editor Alpha because its current focus is on enabling the community to make custom maps using the standard ruleset for PvP games. This release of the editor doesn't include the tools that will be used to edit game data or triggers, but those will be coming in later releases. Be sure to join the #terrain-editor community on the official [url="http://discord.gg/stromgate"][u]Stormgate Discord[/u][/url] for tips, tricks, and even recruit playtesters to help you improve your original creations. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeg78VKf0ax5i2zjaon7Ni7rK3NZlhdzgHQPmc3_ifs1Jx_9IgIBZbCMZrgiC2C7zRjsFVw7FV8QCUxQk_zrMclce0vhnt1UDrJQkbDgeChqdxvLhlLElZNIQEIbOLr34Wz3y38?key=CXiFUsDqdOYfE574oRvGBw"][/img] [/p][p]On top of bringing the Terrain Editor to everyone, we have also added a few new features since our previous round of testing: [/p][list][*][p]Pathing tool[/p][/*][*][p]Rotated tool brushes[/p][/*][*][p]Camera-aligned object box selection[/p][/*][*][p]The collision budget is displayed in the editor[/p][/*][*][p]Minimap shows icons and trees[/p][/*][*][p]Added camera action to focus camera on selection[/p][/*][*][p]Added camera action to show the entire map from above[/p][/*][*][p]New in Editor page under Sigma Labs [/p][/*][*][p]Stormgates can be placed in the editor (there still must be 5)[/p][list][*][p]To add a Stormgate to a map, place a Deactivated Stormgate with a StormgateObjective_TugOfwar on top of it[/p][list][*][p]Deactivated Stormgate units need the following placed names: StormgateObjective1, StormgateObjective2, StormgateObjective3, StormgateObjective4, StormgateObjective5[/p][/*][*][p]StormgateObjective_TugOfWar capture points need the following placed names: StormgateCP1, StormgateCP2, StormgateCP3, StormgateCP4, StormgateCP5[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Co-op: [/b][/h3][p]Co-op is still up and running, and players can continue to enjoy it in its current state. Development on Co-op has been kept on the back-burner while we focused resources on other modes and features, but rest assured, this is not the end. Co-op is an important part of our vision, and we plan to return to it with full focus in future updates. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Custom Games: [/b][/h3][p]Custom Games has been  moved into Sigma Labs to keep it conveniently close to the Terrain Editor. Since Custom Games will be the go-to place for setting up and testing your custom maps, having them side by side makes the creation and playtesting process smoother. [/p][list][*][p]Custom game map names are used in most places[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Stormgates have been reworked to better support FFA[/p][/*][*][p]New loading screen UI to support a larger number of players [/p][/*][*][p]Updated observer/replay UI to support a larger number of players[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Celestials Revamp:[/b][/h2][p]The Celestial Armada has begun its long-awaited revamp, aiming to reduce complexity while preserving the faction's hallmark versatility and mobility. In this patch, we’re focusing on foundational mechanics, with deeper iteration on unit interactions planned for future updates.[/p][p][b]Patch Highlights:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Arcships[/b] now function more like traditional command structures found in other factions. They produce workers, relocate, and cast faction-support abilities.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Collection Arrays[/b] have been significantly streamlined. They no longer act as pseudo-command structures, and all of their abilities have been removed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Prisms[/b] are now aligned with standard worker behavior across factions. Up to 12 can mine from each Luminite mine.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Therium Purifier[/b] has been removed. Prisms now harvest Therium directly, without needing to return it anywhere.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Morph Cores[/b] are no longer produced by Arcships. Instead, most Celestial structures now have an ability called [i]Matter Reallocation[/i], allowing them to refund most of their cost and transform into a Morph Core. This enables flexible repositioning or conversion into other structures.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Power Banks[/b] and [b]Link Nodes[/b] have been merged into a single structure that can freely morph between three key modes:[/p][list][*][p][i]Gracelight Node[/i] (healing)[/p][/*][*][p][i]Energizer Node[/i] (energy restoration)[/p][/*][*][p][i]Judicator Node[/i] (defensive turret)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Aeon Gates[/b] are now tier-2 structures built directly from the command panel.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Power[/b] system has been simplified and no longer includes hidden benefits or effects.[/p][/*][/list][p]For a complete breakdown of changes, see the balance updates below. We have even more changes for the Celestial Armada planned for future patches. Let us know what you think—and enjoy exploring the new Celestials![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Challenger Skirmish: [/b][/h2][p]In this update, AI Skirmish mode has been expanded with two new unique Challengers to face off against, each featuring their own distinct Stats, Units, and Perks that showcase radically different playstyles and philosophies of war. [/p][p][/p][p]These new bot personalities are intentionally built around strong gimmicks, creating bold strategic identities with noticeable strengths and exploitable weaknesses. Their lopsided capabilities present a fun challenge for players to puzzle out, adapt to, and ultimately overcome through creative counterplay.

These are just the first of our new Challengers, with more unique AI opponents planned for future updates, including a Celestial Challenger coming later. [/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXc8bkn_XP0rLvIyMUDIyjjXPjKMIThTkRRmPOR46Ys4K_bcileVu4NXWuoSMXbO4CIccO7YKF6mkXUSpPw5EoVxHA-c5y316lHAvqXBOqqtvMbApvqX3HUtHkrzV51NrnkphNT7?key=CXiFUsDqdOYfE574oRvGBw"][/img][/p][p][b]Major Galt: [/b][i]The Commander[b] - [/b][/i][b]Faction[/b]: Vanguard[/p][p]Commands a Havoc faction infamous for their loyalty and relentless aggression. A charismatic mercenary-king, the Major’s speeches rally his ragtag soldiers into a frothing devotion, driving them and their machinery of war to the absolute limit. He is a walking contradiction: reckless but effective, arrogant but admired, and outrageous…but deeply dangerous. [/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcycqhSkLms4XtFW0uBReDGugOP193v2zF_9XJqaVX0-E6cpJR37FUGvexoSvKiDTEpHyjTVacXpjk0KE5KYoriGfeJF7-1uId-aFyArv7JbgDk6sO5rK5u9Itd6kp6QladDxSBOg?key=CXiFUsDqdOYfE574oRvGBw"][/img][b]Vokurka: [/b][i]The Hag - [/i][b]Faction[/b]: Infernal[/p][p]Serves the Infernal Host as a conduit to the spirit realm, tapping into their honored cycle of life and death and harnessing its momentum to fuel her dark magic. Phantoms swarm as Vokurka’s Curse assails her enemies. Her summoned spirits fear no end, embracing their demise as yet another chance at victory. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Campaign and Ladder Reset:[/b] [/h2][p][b]Campaign Progress Reset: [/b]We are resetting certain hero progression elements, but your overall campaign progress will remain intact. This means all completed campaign levels, along with the difficulties you've cleared them on during Early Access, will be preserved. However, hero-specific progress—such as hero levels, items, and talents—will be reset to ensure a fresh and balanced start.[/p][p][b]Ladder Reset: [/b]The competitive ladder is also being reset. All players will start from the same point, offering a fair opportunity to climb the ranks and compete in the new season.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Player Profiles and Account Progression: [/b][/h2][p]This update introduces the first version of [i]Stormgate’s [/i]account progression system. Players can now level up their Vanguard, Infernal, and Celestial races by earning [b]Storm Points[/b] through Campaign, Co-op, Versus, and Skirmish matches (Custom Games support coming later!). As you progress, you’ll unlock a new type of cosmetic, Player Card Nameplates, which are displayed on your in-game Player Card and reflect your race-specific progression. [img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdVVxGMNTktjFExd8bMB6gwaj6Q_WKr1z9WjfaBXjR3w6O8e0US9Bft6CXhT7FgHensXkbTVEtc1dRRkYEiU7R_HkcLqiVpmU6P9GMzJMqDxuUTXoTyAFVJlnwCbFBcLevEQNgg?key=CXiFUsDqdOYfE574oRvGBw"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Steam Profile Pictures: [/b]Your Steam avatar is now displayed as your profile picture in game. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Progression Types: [/b]We have added a couple types of progression to be aware of beyond Versus Ranks/Leagues and Co-op Commander levels that already exist.[/p][list][*][p][b]Account Levels: [/b]Playing any mode contributes to your overall Account Level which is usually visible on your portrait.  Reaching a higher Account Level will increase your Account Tier, upgrading the borders around your portrait and player card.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Faction Levels: [/b]Additionally, playing in any mode will level up whichever of the three main factions is associated with what you just played.  For example, playing as Maloc in Co-op will increase your Infernals faction level, and playing the Vanguard Campaign will increase your Vanguard faction level.  We have added a handful of nameplates that appear behind your name on your player card that can be unlocked by leveling up the different factions.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Steam Integration Improvements:[/b] We’ve made improvements to how Stormgate connects with Steam, making it easier than ever to find and connect with your Steam friends in-game. This is just the beginning—expect more enhancements in future updates. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Steam Achievements: [/b][/h2][p]Steam Achievements are finally here! In this first iteration, we've focused on Campaign mode, adding 36 achievements—3 for each of the 12 missions. These range from straightforward objectives to hidden challenges, rewarding players for strategy, exploration, and mastery. Here is the full list of these new achievements: [/p][list][*][p][b]Mission 1: Ghosts of the Past: [/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Ghost of the Past (Brutal)[/b] - Complete the mission “Ghost of the Past” on Brutal difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lost and Found[/b] - Locate the secret stash in the mission “Ghost of the Past”.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unnatural Selection[/b] - Kill the Incarnate in the mission “Ghost of the Past”.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Mission 2: City of Skulls[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]City of Skulls (Brutal)[/b] - Complete the mission “City of Skulls” on Brutal difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Xenobotanist[/b] - Locate all flora samples in the mission “City of Skulls”[/p][/*][*][p][b]King Nothing[/b] - Defeat the Marauder Warlord in the mission “City of Skulls”.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Mission 3: Ash and Bone[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Ash and Bone (Brutal)[/b] - Complete the mission “Ash and Bone” on Brutal difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fully Operational[/b] - Repair all the abandoned city defenses in the mission “Ash and Bone”.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Not a Scratch[/b] - Don’t let the convoy take more than 250 damage in the mission “Ash and Bone”[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Mission 4: Grim Company[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Grim Company (Brutal)[/b] - Complete the mission “Grim Company” on Brutal difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battlefield Logistics[/b] - Fully upgrade the Artillery Tower and recover all supply caches in the mission “Grim Company”.[/p][/*][*][p][b]No One Left Behind[/b] - Complete the mission “Grim Company” without losing any resistance forces.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Mission 5: Veiled Fate[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Veiled Fate (Brutal)[/b] - Complete the mission “Veiled Fate” on Brutal difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tactical Collapse[/b] - Block all 3 pathways using debris in the mission “Veiled Fate”.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Guardian Angel[/b] - Protect Amara from all damage during the final holdout.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Mission 6: Traitor's Bay[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Traitor’s Bay (Brutal)[/b] - Complete the mission “Traitor's Bay” on Brutal difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Live Free or Die[/b] - Rescue all prisoners in the mission “Traitor’s Bay”.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Their Guns, Our War[/b] - Gain control of all enemy Wall Turrets in the mission “Traitor’s Bay”.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Mission 7: Darkened Skies[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Darkened Skies (Brutal)[/b] - Complete the mission “Darkened Skies” on Brutal difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p][b]System Override[/b] - Secure all weaponized platforms in the mission “Darkened Skies”.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ghost in the Code[/b] - Complete the mission “Darkened Skies” in under 15 minutes.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Mission 8: Destroyer of Worlds[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Destroyer of Worlds (Brutal)[/b] - Complete the mission “Destroyer of Worlds” on Brutal difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Celestial Conduit[/b] - Secure all power sites in the mission “Destroyer of Worlds”.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Avatar of Destruction[/b] - Kill 100 enemies using Arkulus powers in the mission “Destroyer of Worlds”.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Mission 9: Dying Light[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Dying Light (Brutal)[/b] - Complete the mission “Dying Light” on Brutal difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Critical Reserves[/b] - Secure all supply caches in the mission “Dying Light”.[/p][/*][*][p][b]We Keep Them Safe[/b] - Complete the mission “Dying Light” without letting any civilians die.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Mission 10: Into Madness[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Into Madness (Brutal)[/b] - Complete the mission “Into Madness” on Brutal difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tear the Veil[/b] - Destroy all Eldritch Vortexes in the mission “Into Madness”.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Blink and You're Dead[/b] - Destroy a Desolator within 15 seconds of it spawning in the mission “Into Madness” [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Mission 11: Dead Reckoning[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Dead Reckoning (Brutal)[/b] - Complete the mission “Dead Reckoning” on Brutal difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Atlas, Rise[/b] - Reactivate all heavy mechs in the mission “Dead Reckoning”.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cold Hard Cache[/b] - Claim 2500 or more total resources from neutral structures in the mission “Dead Reckoning”.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Mission 12: Edge of Eternity[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Edge of Eternity (Brutal)[/b] - Complete the mission “Edge of Eternity” on Brutal difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Terminal Protocol[/b] - Complete all bonus objectives in the mission “Edge of Eternity”.[/p][/*][*][p][b]No Time for Eternity[/b] - Complete the mission “Edge of Eternity” in less than 15 minutes.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Backer Rewards: Name a Unit [/b][/h2][p]A huge thank you to all the backers who purchased the [i]Name a Unit[/i] perk through Kickstarter or Indiegogo! Your chosen names have now been added to the game and are randomly assigned to units as you build them. Keep an eye out—you might just spot your custom name on the battlefield. The [i]Create an NPC[/i] backer perks are still in the works and will be coming later. We can’t wait to bring those characters to life.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcFxM1czscWx6XiGXzpmS062JNQ0GPLZB-jLoOvTWKB1xtErsDJvn16opXvH0bg5DkIUixeVutg86dyUy-S1-wTHVVGA7xOlwCfE_TondCpOIbYBKK1udQiAYuwTA5zgduGA43Wxg?key=CXiFUsDqdOYfE574oRvGBw"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Twitch Drops – Digital Distortion Fog of War:[/b][/h2][p]From August 5 to September 1, tune into participating Twitch streams to earn the exclusive [b]Digital Distortion Fog of War[/b] cosmetic through Twitch Drops! Just watch eligible streams while logged into your linked account, and the reward will be yours. Don’t miss your chance to add this unique visual effect to your collection! [url="http://playstormgate.com/news/launch-twitch-drop"][u]Click here for the full details of how to redeem drops or enable drops for your stream. [/u][/url][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdwuO1a8WDNrcIFAYBc6YNRgYsIO94PxJG047UCWIICdBHzfIAdC_qCPxEP_7_qTfJIYo9bp1HqZAnhinsPIkSK1TgLamFemCbwnnSR4cmliPCfpI1Rhnp1RWafZElDeVXOVYCn_g?key=CXiFUsDqdOYfE574oRvGBw"][/img][/p][h2][b]Pricing and Bundle Adjustments:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Each of the three paid Campaign chapters is getting a 10% price reduction. You’ll still be able to purchase all three together through the in-game bundle option.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]All Heroes will be 15% off as a temporary offer, due to Team Mayhem being unavailable and no recent Co-op updates.[/p][/*][*][p]The current bundles are being renamed:[/p][list][*][p]Basic Edition[/p][/*][*][p]Deluxe Edition[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]A new Ultimate Edition bundle is being introduced, which now includes the Heroes Ryker and Warz.[/p][list][*][p]The price of this new bundle will increase slightly to reflect the fact that it contains all currently playable content available today.[/p][/*][*][p]Important: If you purchased a previous version of the Ultimate Edition, you will not automatically receive Ryker and Warz. The updated bundle is a separate product.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXctb_QjrNjr5-MpzqlsW26EjzrwGfC_4cPDkxL05D0LB8pdSyqNpVoloBf2SYqFtwZeyydbU8_zN3ZoF0r5Kasf7f4nSggL3XDEkkjTcVzlskcAXavf7yA9PPnIxAUTyfv691A0EA?key=CXiFUsDqdOYfE574oRvGBw"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][h1]Balance Updates: [/h1][p][/p][h2][b]Vanguard[/b][/h2][p][b]Command Post/Central Command/High Command[/b][/p][list][*][p]Servo Overcharge is now a targeted ability.[/p][/*][*][p]Servo Overcharge movement speed bonus decreased from 50% to 30%.[/p][/*][*][p]Servo Overcharge armor bonus increased from 25 to 50.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Rampart[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reinforce no longer autocast for 2 seconds after the Rampart has finished transforming.[/p][/*][*][p]Reinforce will now only autocast on targets that have less than 75% health.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Sentry Posts Variants[/b][/p][list][*][p]Right-click to load will now have a higher priority than right-click to Rally.[/p][/*][*][p]Rally commands will no longer bet set from the Quick Macro Panel.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Flak Cannon[/b][/p][list][*][p]Anti-ground range decreased from 12 to 10.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Hedgehog[/b][/p][list][*][p]Outer radius (How much units bump into other units) decreased from 0.8 to 0.6.[/p][/*][*][p]Inner radius (How much units bump into structures and terrain) decreased from 0.8 to 0.375.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Sentinel[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Sentinels were doing slightly more damage than expected.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Infernals[/b][/h2][p][b]Shrine/Greater Shrine/Elder Shrine[/b][/p][list][*][p]Imp recharge time increased from 17 seconds to 18 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Summon Effigy cooldown increased from 5 seconds to 25 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Summon Effigy cooldown is now decreased by 20 seconds if summoned within Shroud.[/p][/*][*][p]Hellspawn Resurgence cost decreased from 75 energy to 50 energy.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Tribute Pyre[/b][/p][list][*][p]Supply granted increased from 10 to 15.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Shroudstone[/b][/p][list][*][p]Weapon period decreased from 1.8 to 1.3[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Effigy[/b][/p][list][*][p]Vision range increased from 11 to notes.title: Starcraft 2 spiritual successor Stormgate's next update will be a full campaign
notes.content:
I maintain a lot of hope for Starcraft 2 spiritual successor Stormgate. With ex Blizzard veterans helming developer Frost Giant, and worldbuilding assisted by series co-creator Chris Metzen, it's certainly got the chops to follow up the classic RTS the way games like Tempest Rising and 9-Bit Armies have done for Command and Conquer. Early access has been mixed, but there's a long way to go; a lot of improvements have rolled out in the year since launch. Now, Frost Giant reveals that the next Stormgate update will bring its first full campaign, although it stresses that this won't mean a jump to 1.0.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Stormgate update fully overhauls the Starcraft 2 spiritual successor's campaign
notes.content:
I dream of the day we hear about Starcraft 3, or a new Command and Conquer game. But while two of the genre's fundamental linchpins remain quiet, we've seen a real RTS revival with the likes of newcomer Tempest Rising, a fresh Age of Empires 2 update, and the returning Commandos Origins. Stormgate could one day be at the front of that charge, but the free Steam game's initial launch was met with a rather lukewarm reception. As it nears one year in early access, however, developer Frost Giant Studios has made various improvements, and now launches the "biggest leap forward for Stormgate yet."

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Starcraft 2 spiritual successor Stormgate shows off major campaign rework
StarCraft spiritual successor Stormgate adds its most highly requested feature

notes.title: Stormgate 0.4.0 Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=wyfbvikuT58;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re excited to finally share Update 0.4.0, our biggest leap forward for Stormgate yet. 

From the very beginning we set out to create an RTS experience that evolves over time - one that grows with you. With this update, we’re taking a major step toward that vision, and it all starts with a complete Campaign overhaul. We’ve rebuilt the first 6 missions from the ground up with new interludes, new VO, new art, and even new hero customizations to tailor your personal Campaign experience.

With the new Campaign, we also bring new unit models for various Infernal and Vanguard units, all new Hero and NPC models, a complete rework of Amara’s abilities in Campaign, checkpoint save/load improvements, new Campaign post-game stats, and other quality of life features.

Please note that this is a preview of our launch Campaign for testing purposes and not a finished work. If you have been waiting for the completed release of our Campaign before experiencing our story, we recommend that you remain patient and check back in when it’s done. 

That said, there’s plenty for all Stormgate players to see in 0.4.0 outside of Campaign. Check out several all-new unit models, the new AI improvements in Custom Games, the visual upgrade for Infernal Shroud, plus various balance changes, bug fixes, and more!

Thank you for supporting us on this journey. Dive into the full list of updates:  https://playstormgate.com/news/stormgate-patch-0-4-0

[h2]Gameplay: [/h2]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where users would occasionally get kicked out of a game with no error message. 
[*] Fixed an issue where some regions were incorrectly seeing tombstones, green blood, and removal of bones from deceased units on the map.[/list]
[h1]Balance Changes: [/h1]
[h2]General[/h2]
[list][*] Workers:
[list][*] B.O.B.s, Imps, and Prisms no longer have the Light Tag.[/list][/list]
With our changes to worker health across the board, sometimes the ability to kill workers got too volatile. In addition, in the past, we’ve had to balance our anti-Light units around the fact that they could decimate workers, which we felt was too restrictive. These changes will hopefully allow us to better modulate the pace at which workers die as well as design stronger anti-Light units.
[h2]Vanguard: [/h2]
[list][*] B.O.B.:
[list][*] Health increased from 100 to 110.[/list][/list]
Last patch, we greatly decreased the health of workers across the game, and we feel the B.O.B. is now perhaps a bit too vulnerable. In general, we feel that just modifying the health of workers tends to get us into situations where harassment is either too volatile or too difficult. In the future, we’ll be looking for alternate levers to allow us to modulate this dynamic.
[list][*] Lancer:
[list][*] Health decreased from 240 to 210.
[*] Damage increased from 10 (+5 vs Light, +5 vs Structure) to 12 (+3 vs Light, + 3 vs Structure).[/list][/list]
We’re going to tune the Lancer to be more of a brawler than a tank, which we believe will enable more exciting battles, especially on tier-1. In addition, we’ll be reducing the specialized damage this unit has, which was a goal we had stated for all tier-1 units in a previous patch.
[list][*] Exo:
[list][*] Damage increased from 14 (+3 vs Heavy) to 15 (+3 vs Heavy).[/list][/list]
Yes, a +1 damage change on Exos. Last patch, we reduced the range of Exos in order to temper their kiting power and grant more counterplay. We feel this was a change in the right direction, but they’re feeling a bit weak, so we’re giving them just a smidge more power.
[list][*] MedTech:
[list][*] Offensive Nanoswarm damage decreased from 300 damage to 200 damage over 20 seconds.[/list][/list]
We saw some cool suicide plays from MedTechs against Prisms in recent tournaments. Though this was really cool, it’s probably not super healthy in the long run, so we’ll be reverting the amount of damage they can do offensively.
[list][*] Hornet:
[list][*] Fixed an issue where Skymines did not cost Luminite.
[*] Skymine's intended cost decreased from 25 to 10.
[*] Anti-ground damage decreased 8 to 7.[/list][/list]
We fixed an issue where Skymines were not costing the intended amount of money. At the same time, we received feedback that Skymines were too expensive at 25 Luminite, so we’ll try lowering the cost of Skymines in this patch.

In addition, because of the new flocking behavior, we’ve seen air units generally get more powerful. This is especially true for Hornets, units that often receive a powerful area-of-effect defensive Nanoswarm bonus. As such, we’d like to slightly decrease the straight-up fighting power of Hornets against ground units.
[h2]Infernals[/h2]
[list][*] Fiend:
[list][*] Damage decreased from 8 to 7.[/list][/list]
Our most recent buff to Fiends allowed them to be slightly too destructive.
[list][*] Hexen:
[list][*] Fixed a bug where Venom Traps could damage structures.
[*] Miasma range decreased from 13 to 10.
[*] Miasma damage multiplier increased from 8x to 10x.
[list][*] Damage per second increased from 16 to 20.[/list][/list][/list]
We both wanted Miasma to be a stronger threat in general and allow it to have more counterplay.
[list][*] Magmadon:
[list][*] Cost changed from 250/150 to 275/125.[/list]
[*] Hellborne:
[list][*] Cost changed from 250/150 to 300/125.
[*] Hellborne damage changed from 25 (+75 vs Structure) to 30 (+30 vs Heavy, +30 vs Structure).
[*] Shatter damage decreased from 25% bonus to 20% bonus.
[*] Actual splash damage changed from 6.25 (+18.75 vs Structure) to 6 (+6 vs Heavy, +6 vs Structure[/list][/list]
As Therium starvation is one of the biggest complaints from Infernal players, we’d like to tweak some unit costs to lean more towards Luminite. In addition, we’ve received feedback that Infernals could use a stronger single-target anti-heavy weapon since mechanical Vanguard strategies can be sometimes hard for Infernals.
[h2]Celestials[/h2]
[list][*] Collection Array:
[list][*] Build time increased from 90 seconds to 100 seconds.
[*] Morph Core morph time increased from 60 seconds to 70 seconds.[/list]
[*] Prism
[list][*] Build time increased from 55 seconds to 60 seconds.[/list][/list]
Celestial economy was slightly too far ahead relative to the other factions, so we’re making some tweaks to help balance them out.
[list][*] Top-Bar:
[list][*] Purify Power Cost increased from 20 to 30.
[*] Purify Recharge time increased from 120 seconds to 180 seconds.[/list][/list]
As players have gotten better at the game, they’ve learned more about the power of this Top-Bar ability. We’re adjusting the cost and cooldown of the ability to better match its currently perceived power.
[list][*] Arcship:
[list][*] Skyward Salvation heal per second decreased from 15 to 10.
[*] Skyward Salvation duration increased from 20 seconds to 30 seconds.
[*] Total health restored unchanged.[/list][/list]
Skyward Salvation was slightly too powerful in certain rush strategies so we’ve tuned that down without impacting its out-of-combat effectiveness.
[list][*] Argent:
[list][*] Damage decreased from 10 (+3 vs Heavy) to 9 (+2 vs Heavy).
[*] High Energy energy cost decreased from 10 to 5.
[list][*] Resulting High Energy damage changed from 15(+4.5 vs Heavy) to 13.5 (+3 vs Heavy).
[/list][/list][/list]
We wanted Argents to be a more reliable tier-1 unit, so we’re reducing its charged-up damage in exchange for more consistent damage in moderately-long fights.
[list][*] Kri:
[list][*] The Radiant Fury trait now increases Blaze of Light damage by +20 (+20 vs Light), down from 40.[/list][/list]
We’d like to tune Radiant Fury to be more specialized, especially in a way that prevents them from being able to decimate worker lines.
[list][*] Vector:
[list][*] Anti-ground range increased from 3 to 4.
[*] Anti-ground damage changed from 9 to 8 (+2 vs Light).[/list][/list]
Now that workers no longer have the Light tag, we feel more comfortable giving Vectors more of a combat role.
[list][*] Animancer:
[list][*] Fixed an issue where Dark Prophecy would sometimes not deal the intended amount of damage.
[*] Dark Prophecy no longer ramps up in damage over time.[/list][/list]
Behind the scenes, this was one of the most complicated abilities in the game without enough coolness to justify the complexity. We’ll be reducing the complexity to enable it to deal more consistent damage.
[list][*] Archangel:
[list][*] Unit size decreased from 1.2 to 1.[/list][/list]
Archangels still felt a bit too clumsy as a melee unit, and we think they could afford to shrink down a bit given their current art.

notes.title: Hotfix Update 0.3.1
notes.content:
Stormgate brings you Hotfix 0.3.1! With the implementation of fully customizable hotkeys, we knew there would be some bugs that weren’t discovered until the feature truly got in the hands of players. Thank you to everyone that has taken the time to post bugs and feedback after the recent patch as you are the reason we are able to find and fix these bugs so quickly!

[b]In order to implement this patch we will need to enter maintenance mode starting at 11am PT / 1900 UTC / 3am KST.[/b]

[h2]Hotkeys[/h2]
[list]
[*] Allied and enemy morphing units will no longer be added to automated control groups when they morph.
[*] Workers will no longer skip the “Build Structure” submenu if a specific structure’s hotkey is the same as the “Build Structure” hotkey.
[*] Fixed an issue where the “Assign All” button would improperly set hotkeys when switching between “Grid” and “By Command” assignment styles.
[*] Fixed an issue where units that morph would display a non-functional command card button for one morph state when in a selection of mixed morph states.
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Shadowflyers would not apply an area armor debuff when they explode.
[*] Exo turn period decreased.
[*] Vulcan turn period decreased.
[/list]
[h2]Audio[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced the volume and concurrency limit of the Slime and Ooze creep’s basic attacks.
[*] Reduced the volume of the Flayed Dragon weapon impact.
[*] Reduced the volume of the Flayed Dragon’s Fetid Breath ability.
[/list]

notes.title: Stormgate Patch 0.3.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506090/1b473af9033146cdb7cd25ec5317de7df95d27f2.png[/img]

Welcome to the Stormgate Early Access 0.3.0 update, featuring the long-awaited fully customizable hotkey system. The dev team has been working incredibly hard to prepare this update for you, and we’re excited to roll out a variety of quality-of-life changes, improvements, and bug fixes across the entire game on February 25, 2025 when the patch goes live. Be sure to check out the full notes below to check out everything we have in store. 

The Stormgate Early Access 0.3.0 update also includes support for Frost Giant’s upcoming Children’s Hospital of Orange County (CHOC) charity tournament. Everyone can participate for free–you can [url=https://rallycry.gg/stormgate/register]sign up today[/url] and do your part to support kids in need.

As always, thank you for your support! 

[h1]Support[/h1]
How to Install a Patch on Steam:
[list][*] Open Steam
[*] Click on Library to see your games list
[*] Click Downloads at the bottom of the Library window
[*] If the new build does not download automatically, click the Download Now button to manually download the new update[/list]
How to report a bug or provide feedback on the latest build: [url=https://playstormgate.com/feedback]https://playstormgate.com/feedback[/url] 

Still having trouble? Visit our [url=https://support.playstormgate.com/hc/en-us]Stormgate Help Center[/url].

Help us out by leaving a review over on Steam: [url=http://bit.ly/stormgate ]http://bit.ly/stormgate[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506090/a7405bc43d101cc31f3dbe0b15e812be1aded5e0.png[/img]

[h1]Build Spotlight: [/h1]

[h2]Stormgate for CHOC Charity Tournament & Choco Pet:[/h2]

At Frost Giant Studios and RallyCry, we believe that gaming has the power to bring people together—not just for competition, but for a cause. That’s why we’re proud to co-host a tournament in support of CHOC Foundation and Children's Hospital, an institution that provides world-class care for children in need. The Stormgate for CHOC Charity Tournament is free to join and open to all Stormgate players who want to compete for a great cause. Join us this weekend, March 1 and 2, and be sure to bring your friends. The more participants, the higher the prize pool, and the greater the donation to CHOC. Signups are still open! [url=https://playstormgate.com/news/stormgate-for-choc-charity-tournament]See full information here[/url].

To further support the life-saving care provided by CHOC, Frost Giant Studios has stitched together an adorable in-game pet, Choco, modeled after CHOC’s iconic bear mascot which is available for  $6.99. 100% of the net proceeds (less taxes and third party service provider fees) from each Choco adoption fee will go directly to CHOC to fund their cutting-edge pediatric research and programs. 

[previewyoutube=xZ7_IUwsZNk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Hotkeys and Automated Control Groups:[/h2]
There have been a number of changes and improvements to the hotkey system both big and small, including long requested features and support.  We are going to list some of the smaller changes first, because some of the larger changes make use of the smaller changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506090/308727fd494a9b60f41acdba366513fd1417e586.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Alternate Hotkeys[/b]: Stormgate now supports “alternate” hotkeys. You can now assign two hotkeys to the same action.
[*] [b]Steal+Add To Control Group[/b]: Stormgate now supports “Steal+Add To Control Group” hotkeys.  The hotkey for this is Alt+Shift+# (0-9). These allow you to remove your selected units from any existing control groups they are in and add them to a specified control group. For example, if you have 5 Lancers selected and you press Alt+Shift+3, those Lancers will be removed from all control groups they are currently in, but then added to Control Group 3.
[*] [b]Remove From Control Groups:[/b] Stormgate now has a hotkey to remove selected units from all of the control groups they are in without adding them to any control groups. The hotkey for this by default is “Alt+`”.
[*] [b]Cycle Town Halls:[/b] We have added a hotkey (Backspace) to cycle between your ‘Town Halls’ (each faction’s headquarters building).  Pressing this hotkey will select one of your Town Halls and center the camera on it.  If you press this hotkey repeatedly, it will cycle between your Town Halls one after the other, eventually looping back to the first.
[*] [b]Cycle Quick Macro Tabs:[/b] We have added an assignable hotkey for cycling between quick macro tabs. Pressing this hotkey will open the first available quick macro tab, and pressing it repeatedly will cycle between the rest of the available quick macro tabs in order, eventually looping back to the first. The primary purpose of this hotkey is to improve accessibility for input devices with limited available buttons for players who use them. This hotkey is bound to ‘O’ by default.
[*] [b]Per-Command Hotkeys (AKA “Fully Customizable Hotkeys”):[/b] We have added the ability to assign hotkeys based on individual commands instead of just based on grid position. Grid position hotkeys are still available. You can access the new (and old) hotkey options by using the “Hotkeys” button on the Escape menu, both in and out of game.
[*] [b]Automated Control Groups Customization:[/b] We have also added the ability to customize Automated Control Groups. You can now decide for yourself what groups you want each unit to go into. You can access Automated Control Group customization through the “Control Groups” button on the Escape menu, both in and out of game.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506090/a89f275cd13dcb564e408bc7a617f965864d697a.png[/img]
In addition, we have also made a couple of changes to the default settings for Automated Control Groups and the “Select All Army” button.
[list][*] We no longer assign Automated Control Groups to keys 1, 2, and 3 by default.
[*] All army units now automatically go into Control Group 10 (0) by default.
[*] We have changed the default hotkey for “Select All Army” to “M”.
[*] We have added “Spacebar” as an alternate hotkey for Control Group 10 (0) by default.[/list]
The goal for these changes is to provide players with a "Select All Army" key that they can optionally remove units of their choosing from so those units will no longer be selected with the key alongside the rest of their army.  For example, if you want to leave your S.C.O.U.T. in some bushes on Hold Position, but still want to be able to use your “Select All Army” key, you can use the “Remove From Control Groups” hotkey to make it no longer selectable using your pseudo “Select All Army” key, which is really just Control Group 10 (0) now.

For players who prefer the old way that Select All Army functions, the hotkey still exists and can be rebound from M back to Spacebar.

We will continue to make changes and improvements to the hotkey system and would appreciate your feedback on these updates.

[previewyoutube=wDhAkGUy2fM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Patch Notes: [/h1]

[h2]General:[/h2]
[list][*] [b]Twitch In-Client Embed[/b]
[list][*] Twitch streams can now be featured directly in the Stormgate client.[/list]
[*] [b]Flyer Flocking[/b]
[list][*] Flocking flight behavior allows for flying units to overlap with one another in order to reach a destination.
[list][*] A flying unit may pass through another flying unit to reach a goal.
[*] Overlapping flying units in motion will seek to spread out from other flying units in motion.
[*] Overlapping motionless flying units will seek to spread out from other motionless flying units.
[*] Units must spread out before they can attack.[/list][/list]
[*] [b]Projectile Movement Behavior[/b]
[list][*] Abilities that launch the unit as a projectile along a curved path (Heroic Leap, Tuck and Roll) will look more smooth.
[*] Arcing projectiles (Mortardon, Atlas) now have more natural arcs and will reach a higher apex to cover longer distances.
[*] Removed a brief visual delay before projectiles disappeared at their impact location.[/list]
[*] [b]Unit Turning[/b]
[list][*] Units now have turn smoothing, so they no longer turn at constant rotation rates. While turning to approach their intended facing angle, units’ rotation will slow down, which results in more natural looking movement.[/list]
[*] [b]Camera Smoothing Setting:[/b]
[list][*] This game option now has three tiers of camera smoothing for edge, arrow and drag scrolling. The highest setting is great for observers.[/list]
[*] [b]Pre-Game Countdown:[/b]
[list][*] A countdown to match start will now take place in non-campaign games after loading is complete. [/list]
[*] [b]Pause[/b]
[list][*] You may now pause the game in any mode.
[*] Players are limited to three pauses while in games with other players.[/list]
[*][b] Area of Effect Targeting Affected Unit Indicators[/b]
[list][*] When targeting various area-of-effect abilities, friendly units will be highlighted in green if the ability affects them and enemy units will be highlighted in red.[/list]
[*][b] Range Indicators[/b]
[list][*] Range Indicators will correctly visualize range when range is upgraded via research.[/list]
[*][b] Error Messaging[/b]
[list][*] You will receive more error messages when you cannot use an ability for a specific reason. (i.e. ‘Target must be damaged’ or ‘Not enough stored Bombers’). Even more error messages are coming in a future patch.[/list]
[*] [b]Replay Vision Switching[/b]
[list][*] You may now switch perspectives while watching replays.[/list]
[*][b] Postgame Scores and Kudos[/b]
[list][*] Postgame graphs will now illustrate the flow of the game, including the following:
[list][*] Army Value
[*] Luminite Gathered
[*] Therium Gathered
[*] Luminite Bank
[*] Therium Bank
[*] Creep Resource Bounty
[*] Resources Spent on Research
[*] Expansion Count
[*] Worker Count[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506090/9dc5b3d1fa92c0b37b9e9525ac74badfa3c3eab1.png[/img]
[*] After a game ends, you will be awarded kudos, highlighting something you did well in that game[/list]
[*] You will now receive an audio alert and minimap ping when an upgrade completes.
[*] You may now choose to enable or disable Rollback in a menu setting.
[*] When you quit a game via the in-game menu, your client will no longer try to rejoin the game.[/list]

[h2]Art: [/h2]
[list][*] [b]VFX:[/b]
[list][*] We’ve completed a large visual effects pass with the following goals:
[list][*] Increase polish and add visual quality overall.
[*] Increase battle readability by quickening impacts, reducing the size or opacity of effects that obscure the battlefield.
[*] Add custom VFX that were previously missing or placeholder.
[*] Dissipate VFX more gracefully.[/list]
[*] A few notable specific effect improvements:
[list][*] Explosions are now more epic and detailed.
[*] Lights and heat distortion added to many effects.
[*] Unit & structure death visuals improved.
[*] New Infernal and construction effects, signaling the beginning of an upcoming Infernal style change.
[*] Flayed Dragon scaled up in size; new effects added.
[*] Collection Arrays now have mining effects.
[*] New attack and move UI pings.[/list][/list]
[*] [b]Lighting:[/b]
[list][*] Standardized lighting system with new exposure values built for continuity across maps.
[*] Time-of-day system can now incorporate a moving sun and moon, adding new life to our environments.
[list][*] Currently testing on Infested Crater and two custom versus maps: TitansCausewayDayNight, and IsleofDread Stormy. Let us know what you think. Should we add these to the competitive map pool?[/list]
[*] Units & structures have received material updates to brighten their darker areas so that they generally look better at night and in the shadows.[/list]
[*] [b]Animation:[/b]
[list][*] A new walk animation has been added for Vulcans. 
[*] Updated the Lancer’s attack animation to play at the correct speed.[/list]
[*] [b]Misc:[/b] 
[list][*] Terrain textures have been improved to increase visual detail, enhance blending, and bring out specular highlights to accentuate the new lighting.
[list][*] The Forest Autumn tileset has been considerably darkened.[/list]
[*] New model for the Skymine.
[*] Updated Luminite Mine art.
[*] Updated Shroud visuals.
[*] Updated Fog of War border look.
[*] Blockade has received a new look. 
[list][*] Note: UI/Portraits are not yet updated to the new look. [/list][/list][/list]

[h2]Audio:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a mute setting and in-game toggle hotkey.
[*] Large pass on volume levels and concurrency values of all the gameplay sound effects in the game for more audible battles and less volume disparity between units and abilities.
[*] Decreased the length of various gameplay sound effects.
[*] Removed most of the sounds that units make when they walk across the battlefield.
[*] New audio for the Animancer’s Dark Prophecy.
[*] New audio for the Flayed Dragon.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list][*] [b]General:[/b]
[list][*] Repeat-keys now function correctly for training units in the quick macro panel.
[*] Cancelling a unit will now always only cancel one unit unless the key is held.
[*] Workers carrying resources no longer fail to deposit their resources when shift-queued to build and then mine.
[*] Workers no longer sometimes get into a stuck state when returning resources.
[*] Workers no longer get stuck waiting to mine after being repeatedly issued harvest orders.
[*] Top bar abilities no longer sometimes display incorrect cooldown information when pinged.
[*] The party inviter’s ID is no longer sometimes missing in the party invite message. [/list]
[*] [b]Versus:[/b]
[list][*] B.O.B.s and Imps no longer sometimes continue to mine from invisible Luminite mines after the mine has been depleted.
[*] Infernal structures will no longer consume charges without spawning a unit if the spawn area is too crowded or the queue is full.
[*] Felhogs are no longer included in drag-selection.
[*] Shroudweave now correctly targets a location instead of a structure.
[*] Vectors do not leave behind beams in certain situations.[/list]
[*] [b]Co-op:[/b]
[list][*] Blockade now starts with a Guardsman instead of a Crusader when equipping the Range Amplifier gear.
[*] Amara’s Protect the Backline teamwide passive no longer applies to units and structures it shouldn’t. 
[*] Maloc’s abilities can no longer be queued multiple times.
[*] Maloc’s Buster Amplification upgrade is no longer missing. 
[*] Warz’s Flayed Dragon now spawns with full health while using Shroud Infusion.
[*] Auralanna will now heal a manually targeted unit until it is full health.
[*] Kastiel can now build Prisms from the quick macro panel while Level 3+.
[*] Kastiel’s research can no longer be added to the research queue multiple times.
[*] Sic! no longer repeatedly casts unintentionally .
[*] Scavengers art has been centered.
[*] Eager Volunteers gear now reduces the resource cost of biological units correctly. 
[*] Weavers no longer benefit from Kastiel’s Range Amplifier gear.
[*] Imp-ressive Harvesting gear now properly increases income.
[*] When using Therium Replication, Prism resource floating text now correctly reflects the amount gathered.
[*] Units costs reduced by the Eager Volunteers gear no longer require the un-reduced amount of resources to build.
[*] Graven Sense can no longer be accidentally triggered multiple times.[/list]
[*] [b]Replays:[/b]
[list][*] The “Watch Solo” is no longer grayed out when you initially switch to the Replay tab.
[*] When rewinding a replay past a loaded cargo unit, the loaded units will no longer vanish from existence.
[*] Units killed in a replay are no longer invisible after rewinding the replay before their death.
[*] Players can no longer move their camera outside of map bounds during replays or observation.
[*] The Unit Info Panel now correctly updates while gameplay is paused in a replay. [/list]
[*] [b]Art:[/b]
[list][*] The Saber’s attack VFX will now appear when attacking a target in Fog of War. 
[*] The Wraithstone’s slow debuff visuals correctly scale to unit size. 
[*] Prism has updated build icon art. 
[*] Summoned units destroyed by Kastiel’s Cancellation Pulse now play a death animation.
[*] Kastiel’s Darkfire Taunt now plays a VFX on affected units.
[*] Kastiel’s gear no longer changes icons when entering/exiting gameplay. 
[*] When attacking a structure, Spriggan attack VFX will now appear towards the direction the Spriggan is standing instead of around the corner.
[*] Projectiles no longer linger at their point of contact. 
[*] Projectile collision impact on Infernal Structures appears more centered.
[*] Projectile impact collision appears consistent with all Shroudstones.
[*] Magmadon animation will no longer cancel the trample animation when attacking. 
[*] Infested Crater no longer appears significantly more foggy when playing on Low/Med settings. The map is slightly more foggy on Low, but acceptably so
[*] Lobbed projectiles against air units are no longer misaligned from their target.
[*] Exo (and variants) projectile beam is now aligned properly. 
[*] The Aberrant’s attack projectile against air units now has a straight trajectory. 
[*] Darkspeed is no longer missing VFX. [/list]
[*] [b]Audio:[/b]
[list][*] Fixed various issues where sounds would not obey the Master Volume and SFX Volume mixers.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain death sounds would not play.
[*] Hoplite move SFX no longer causes audio to cut out or restart.
[*] Auralanna has found her voice and is no longer quieter than other units.
[*] Ryker’s Follow and Move audio no longer overlaps.
[*] Ghost and Shadow now play a “poof” SFX on death.
[*] Ryker’s Unleash! Ability now has a cast SFX. 
[*] Auralanna now has a unit response for the Stop command. 
[*] In Turf War, the first transmission is no longer cut off by the second. 
[*] Designate Prime Structure no longer has VO.
[*] Ryker no longer interrupts himself when playing move VO.
[*] The Atlas’s deployed attack no longer ducks all other game SFX.[/list]
[*] [b]Buddybot:[/b]
[list][*] Buddybot no longer sometimes builds structures when the option is unchecked in the menu.
[*] Buddybot now properly spawns Prisms from Collection Arrays instead of Arcships.
[*] The Auralanna Buddybot will no longer make Scanners unless the build army setting is on.[/list][/list]

[h1]Balance Notes and Commentary: [/h1]
Hey all!

Stormgate 0.3.0 is here, and it’s one of the most significant updates we’ve ever released, especially for the 1v1 versus mode. We’ve made a host of improvements aimed at enhancing the player experience, including one of the most requested features: fully customizable hotkeys on a per-command basis. On top of that, we’re thrilled to introduce fully customizable, automated control groups, designed to streamline gameplay and improve overall efficiency.

We’re also excited to unveil flyer flocking—a new mechanic that allows flying units to pass through each other. This change aims to make air units feel more responsive and fluid to control, while ensuring that flyer stacking isn’t too dominant.

Additionally, we’re making several balance adjustments to better align the game with our long-term vision. Here are some of the key changes coming in this patch:

[h2]Economic Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*] Starting Therium node count increased from 3 to 5.
[*] B.O.B. Therium backpack capacity increased from 6 to 7.
[*] Imp Therium backpack capacity increased from 6 to 7.
[*] Collection Array cost decreased from 550/0 to 450/0.
[*] Collection Array cost when built from Morph Core decreased from 450/0 to 350/0.
[/list]
We’re pleased with the direction of recent economic changes but believe these minor adjustments will further refine the balance between Luminite and Therium in the early game. These changes should also reduce the lulls Celestial players experience, especially when building their first Collection Array.

[h2]Increase Harassment Opportunities[/h2]
[h3]B.O.B.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Health decreased 130 to 100.
[/list]
[h3]Imp[/h3]
[list]
[*] Health decreased from 80 to 70. White Health unaffected.
[/list]
[h3]Flame Imp[/h3]
[list]
[*] Health decreased from 80 to 70. White Health unaffected.
[*] No longer sets their White Health to 0 when they transform.
[/list]
[h3]Power Banks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cost increased from 100/0 to 125/0.
[*] Health decreased from 300 to 250.
[*] Power produced increased from 15 to 20.
[*] Footprint decreased from 3x3 to 2x2.
[/list]
These changes are aimed at enhancing harassment opportunities for all factions. We also want Power Banks to be more valuable harassment targets while making Celestial base layouts more flexible.
[h3]Evac[/h3]
[list]
[*] Movement speed increased from 5 to 5.5.
[*] The Skysprint Retrofit upgrade still increases movement speed by 25%. The resulting movement speed increased from 6.25 to 6.88.
[/list]
[h3]Harbinger[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cost decreased from 100/150 to 100/100.
[/list]
These adjustments should improve the effectiveness of drops as a harassment tool.

[h2]Artillery Unit Reworks[/h2]
[h3]Atlas[/h3]
[list]
[*] Deployed weapon missile speed increased from 18 to 22.
[*] Plasma Arc Infusion upgrade research time decreased from 90 seconds to 60 seconds.
[*] Will now look for a new target with 5 range to attack during their weapon swing if the target of their current attack has died.
[/list]
[h3]Helicarrier[/h3]
[list]
[*] Health increased from 500 to 600.
[*] Bomber health decreased from 200 to 100.
[*] Bomber movement speed decreased from 12 to 10.
[/list]
[h3]Hellborne[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cost decreased from 250/200 to 250/150.
[*] Weapon swing time decreased from 1.4 to 0.7.
[*] Weapon backswing time decreased from 1.1 to 0.55.
[*] Weapon period decreased from 4 to 3.
[*] Weapon damage changed from 50 (+50 vs Structure) to 25 (+75 vs Structure).
[*] Single-target vs unit DPS decreased from 12.5 to 8.33.
[*] Single-target vs structure DPS increased from 25 to 33.33.
[*] Weapon cone damage changed from 12.5 (+12.5 vs Structure) to 6.25 (+18.75 vs Structure).
[*] Will now look for a new target with 5 range to attack during their weapon swing if the target of their current attack has died, increased from 3.
[/list]
[h3]Saber[/h3]
[list]
[*] Range decreased from 14 to 11.
[*] Damage changed from 60 (+30 vs Heavy) to 40 (+50 vs Heavy).
[/list]
We’re making these changes to address feedback on artillery units:
[list]
[*] [b]Improved Usability:[/b] Atlas and Hellborne had long weapon swing times, which were frustrating for high-level players attempting precise micro. We’ve adjusted various aspects of these units for a smoother experience.
[*] [b]More Interaction Opportunities:[/b] Extremely long-range units can be frustrating to counter. We’ve made changes to the Helicarrer and Saber to encourage more interaction.
[*] [b]Specialization and Counterplay:[/b] Players more familiar with classic Blizzard RTSes often associate artillery units with units that also provide crowd-control splash damage. (The Siege Tank, Reaver, Lurker, Colossus, and all Warcraft III siege units fall into this category.) One issue with this design is that if these units don’t have sufficient weaknesses and counterplay, they can often create deathball situations. We feel the Hellborne and Saber have this issue, so we’ll be moving closer to a model set by RTS games such as Age of Empires or Company of Heroes franchises where artillery units are much more specialized and fulfill more specific functions.
[/list]
[h2]Vanguard[/h2]
[h3]Lancer[/h3]
[list]
[*] Health decreased from 260 to 240.
[/list]
The Lancer was slightly too durable and cost-effective, particularly against Infernals. This adjustment should bring its power level more in line with its cost.
[h3]Exo[/h3]
[list]
[*] Range decreased from 7 to 6.
[/list]
This change aims to reduce the Exo’s kiting potential, which could create frustrating, non-interactive scenarios, especially against Infernals, where it previously outranged Gaunts by 2.
[h3]MedTech[/h3]
[list]
[*] Nanoswarm energy cost decreased from 50 to 40.
[*] Nanoswarm damage against enemies increased from 10 to 15 per second.
[/list]
We want to encourage more strategic use of Nanoswarm in the early game, particularly as an offensive tool.
[h3]Vulcan[/h3]
[list]
[*] Weapon range decreased from 8 to 7.
[/list]
The Vulcan was overly effective at zoning out opposing tier-1 units. This adjustment should make engagements against it more interactive.
[h3]Sentinel[/h3]
[list]
[*] Health increased from 200 to 250.
[*] The Sentinel Adept Training upgrade research cost decreased from 100/100 to 50/50.
[*] The Sentinel Master Training upgrade no longer requires a High Command. Requires a Central Command instead.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Master Training upgrade was not increasing the energy regeneration of Sentinels.
[/list]
We believe Nano-defense Bubble is an exciting zone-control ability, and these changes aim to encourage more frequent and strategic usage of the Sentinel.

[h2]Infernals[/h2]
[h3]Infest[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now deals a fixed 2 damage per second rather than 1% of a target’s health pool.
[/list]
This change shifts Infest towards being more effective against small units, rather than serving as a general-purpose damage-over-time effect. Units with less than 200 HP will take more damage, while those with more than 200 HP will take less.
[h3]Wraithstone[/h3]
[list]
[*] Movement speed debuff decreased from 40% to 30%.
[/list]
[h3]Felhog[/h3]
[list]
[*] Health decreased from 60 to 40.
[*] White Health decreased from 15 to 10.
[/list]
We’d like to promote harassment by reducing the effectiveness of these two defensive tools.
[h3]Fiend[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage increased from 7 to 8.
[/list]
This is intended as a slight buff for both Fiends and Brutes, as they are currently underperforming.
[h3]Brute[/h3]
[list][*] The Sundering Soul Craze upgrade has been reworked. It now increases the movement speed of Brutes by +25% and grants Brutes +1 Fiend on death.
[list][*] Brute Movement speed increased from 4 to 5.[/list][/list]
We’re making Brutes faster and reworking their tier-3 upgrade to be more impactful, addressing feedback that Infernal units can feel sluggish. You’ll notice all of the Infernal units in this patch will receive a similar movement speed treatment.
[h3]Gaunt[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage decreased from 8 (+4 vs Light) to 8 (+2 vs Light).
[*] The Reaper’s Rush upgrade now increases the movement speed of Gaunts by +35%, up from +25%. 
[/list]
The resulting movement speed increased from 5 to 5.4.
We're continuing with our philosophy of reducing specialized bonus damage on tier-1 units to avoid polarizing early-game matchups. Additionally, we’re restoring some of the Gaunt’s previous movement speed to bring back its fun, fast-paced playstyle.
[h3]Magmadon[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Raging Tendons upgrade’s movement speed bonus increased from 25% to 30%. The resulting speed increased from 4.38 to 4.55.
[*] Weapon period decreased from 2.1 to 1.8.
[/list]
These buffs should make Magmadons feel more impactful and better at catching enemy units while Trampling.
[h3]Weaver[/h3]
[list]
[*] Movement speed increased from 2.5 to 3.
[*] The Shroudwalk trait now grants a 50% movement speed bonus on Shroud, down from 60%. The resulting movement speed increased from 4 to 4.5.
[*] Can no longer Shroudweave.
[/list]
These changes should make Weavers feel more fluid when moving across the map, while the removal of Shroudweave opens up more harassment opportunities as Weavers won’t be able to instantly respond.
[h3]Shadowflyer[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bloodburst range decreased from 5 to 1.
[*] Single-target damage changed from 50 (+20 vs Heavy) to 45 (+15 vs Heavy).
[*] Area damage decreased from 25 (+10 vs Heavy) to 15 (+5 vs Heavy).
[/list]
After the flyer flocking changes in this patch, flying units will be more able to stack on top of each other. This will cause flying units to be slightly more powerful and anti-air splash damage to be much more powerful. We’ll be monitoring both the strength of flyers and anti-air splash damage after this patch, but in anticipation of these changes, we’ll be reducing the strength of what is often regarded as the most powerful anti-air unit in the game.
[h3]Flayed Dragon[/h3]
[list]
[*] Animus cost increased from 150 to 200.
[*] The Inhale Poison upgrade has been removed. Flayed Dragons can now Inhale Poison without an upgrade.
[/list]
We felt like the Animus cost for a Flayed Dragon was slightly too trivial and locking the Inhale Poison ability behind the upgrade didn’t create interesting gameplay.

[h2]Celestials[/h2]
[h3]Kri[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Radiant Fury upgrade now increases the damage done by Blaze of Light from +20 to +40. Resulting damage increased from 40 to 60.
[/list]
We’ll be enhancing Kri’s late-game impact, ensuring they remain useful beyond the early game.
[h3]Cabal[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Cabal Adept Training upgrade cost decreased from 100/100 to 50/50.
[*] Gravity Flux missile speed decreased from 15 to 10.
[/list]
We’ll be bringing the Adept training cost to a similar cost as those of the other factions as well as slowing Gravity Flux down so that there can be more room for a Vanguard player to react with Return to Hanger.
[h3]Seraphim[/h3]
[list]
[*] Movement speed increased from 4.5 to 5.
[*] Resolute Seal energy cost decreased from 50 to 25.
[/list]
We’d like to increase the movement speed of this unit so it has a better chance to run away from its anti-air counters for continued harassment. In addition, we feel Resolute Seal is so rarely used that it would be appropriate to give it a significant buff.
[h3]Animancer[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Animancer Adept Training upgrade cost decreased from 100/100 to 50/50.
[*] Dark Prophecy no longer requires channeling.
[*] Dark Prophecy range decreased from 13 to 9.
[*] Dark Prophecy cooldown decreased from 15 seconds to 2 seconds.
[*] Dark Prophecy duration decreased from 8 seconds to 4 seconds.
[*] Dark Prophecy slow% reduction decreased from 25% to 15%.
[*] Dark Prophecy now ramps up in damage every second: 20 → 25 → 30 → 35 DPS
[*] At the end of the Dark Prophecy, units are dealt 50 additional damage.
[/list]
We’ve gotten a lot of positive feedback about the changes we’ve made to Miasma in the last patch, rebalancing it as an instant cast ability rather than a channeling ability. We’ll be making similar changes to Dark Prophecy with a goal of improving the power of this ability as we’ve received feedback that it’s currently feeling a bit on the weaker side.
[h3]Archangel[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Scorched Earth upgrade research time decreased from 120 seconds to 90 seconds.
[/list]
While we didn’t necessarily want players to come out with fully-powered Archangels out of the gate, we felt this research took too long.

We’re excited to see how these changes play out and look forward to hearing your feedback. See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Stormgate for CHOC Charity Tournament
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506090/1c92a8abd320cbcff37ae1b88414aad1b88ce834.png[/img]

[h2]Join Us for the Stormgate for CHOC Charity Tournament![/h2]

Frost Giant Studios and [url=https://about.rallycry.gg/]RallyCry [/url]are excited to announce the Stormgate for CHOC Charity Tournament, benefiting the CHOC Foundation and Children’s Hospital of Orange County. This upcoming in-game competition is founded on a belief that video games can be a force for good.

The [i]Stormgate [/i]for CHOC Charity Tournament is free to join and open to all [i]Stormgate [/i]players who want to compete for a great cause.

Tournament Details:
[list]
[*] When:
[list][*] March 1 at 10:00 a.m. PST / 18:00 GMT
[*] March 2 at 12:00 p.m. PST / 20:00 GMT[/list]
[*] Format: Open signup; single elimination, best-of-three bracket
[*] Co-Streaming: Streaming is available (contact mweber@frostgiant.com for details)
[*] Prize: Minimum $1,000[/list]
Frost Giant Studios staff will be making an additional US$250 donation to CHOC for every 100 players who compete in at least one match in the tournament, so be sure to bring your friends! [url=https://rallycry.gg/stormgate/landing]Sign up here[/url].

[h2]Support CHOC by adopting the exclusive Choco in-game Pet[/h2]

To further support the life-saving care provided by CHOC, Frost Giant Studios has stitched together an adorable in-game pet bear, Choco, modeled after CHOC’s iconic mascot. This one-of-a-kind huggable companion is available for US$6.99, and 100% of proceeds (less platform fees and taxes) go directly to CHOC to fund their cutting-edge pediatric research and programs. Choco will become available for purchase when the next Stormgate patch goes live, end of February.

[previewyoutube=xZ7_IUwsZNk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]FAQ[/h2]
[b]Q: Who can participate in the tournament?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] The [i]Stormgate [/i]for CHOC charity tournament is open to [i]Stormgate [/i]players of all skill levels! Whether you're a casual player or a seasoned pro, everyone is welcome to join and play for a great cause.

[b]Q: Do I have to donate to participate?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] No donation is required to enter. However, we encourage participants to [b]support CHOC[/b] by purchasing the [b]Choco in-game Pet[/b] (100% of the proceeds, less taxes and platform fees, will go to CHOC), [b]by recruiting friends to participate[/b] (for every 100 participants, members of the Frost Giant team will personally donate an additional US$250 to CHOC, up to a cap of US$2,000), or by donating directly to CHOC at this [url=https://chocfoundation.donorsupport.co/page/FUNJGYWANMM?utm_medium=digital&utm_source=website&utm_campaign=digital_website_corporate_FrostGiant&utm_content=StormGate]link[/url].

[b]Q: Where can I go to buy the Choco pet bear?
A: [/b] He is for sale in the [i]Stormgate [/i]in-game store.

[b]Q: Why is the Choco pet US$6.99 instead of US$4.99 like the other Stormgate pets?
A: [/b]We raised the fee to compensate for the platform fees and taxes that will be taken out of the revenue in order to maximize the funds the charity will receive.

[b]Q:  What time does the tournament start?
A:[/b] It starts at 10am PST / 6pm (18:00) GMT on March 1, 2025. Follow the bracket results live on the RallyCry platform.

[b]Q: How do I sign up for the CHOC tournament?
A: [/b]You can register by clicking [url=https://rallycry.gg/stormgate/competition/2026/settings/manage-teams]here [/url]and completing the sign-up process. Make sure to join before the registration cutoff at 8am PT/4pm (16:00) GMT on March 1, 2025.

[b]Q: What is the tournament format?
A:[/b] The event is a 1v1 brawl and will follow a single-elimination format with best-of-3 matches. Finals will be best-of-5.

[b]Q: What are the rules?
A:[/b] All players must follow the [b]official tournament rules[/b], which include fair play guidelines, match procedures, and a code of conduct. Read the full rules [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1dMMirsfSCMXg-TSuKHmZnhVUV5fY6a1VkPGrZwI6v7M/edit?tab=t.0]here[/url].

[b]Q: Will the event be streamed?
A:[/b] Yes! The semi-finals and finals will be [b]live-streamed[/b] on Twitch and co-streamed and re-hosted in many languages so friends, family, and fans can watch.  Keep watching the [url=https://playstormgate.com/news/1]playstormgate.com blog[/url] for the full viewing list! (Interested in being one of our co-streamers? Reach out to mweber@frostgiant.com.)

[b]Q: How do I report match results?
A:[/b] Players should submit their [b]match results via RallyCry platform[/b] immediately after each game.

[b]Q: What prizes are available?
A:[/b] The [b]prize pool[/b] starts at [b]$1000 (50/30/10/10 split over top 4 places)[/b], with bonus amounts unlocked as more players join. Frost Giant will i[b]ncrease the total prize pool by $250 for every 100 players[/b] who sign up and actually compete in at least one match  (up to a cap of $5,000). Additionally, Frost Giant devs will personally[b] donate an additional $250 to CHOC for every 100 participants that compete[/b] (up to a cap of $2,000).  So bring your friends!

[b]Q: Do I have to donate to be eligible for prizes?
A:[/b] No! All registered players are eligible to compete for prizes.

[b]Q: When will prizes be distributed?
A: [/b]Prizes will be distributed [b]within 10 days[/b] after the event ends. Winners will be contacted via email or Discord.

[b]Q: What happens if I have a technical issue?
A:[/b] If you experience connection issues or game crashes, report them [b]immediately via the Tournament Discord to a tournament admin[/b]. Admins will review cases individually.

[b]Q: Who do I contact for support?
A:[/b] The easiest way to reach a [b]tournament admin is via the Tournament Discord.[/b]  You can also use the 'Contact Support' button on the nav bar on the RallyCry platform (but response times may be slightly longer.)

[b]Q: What is CHOC? 
A: [/b]CHOC is a charitable foundation and children's hospital based in California which is part of a [b]global pediatric research network[/b] contributing to clinical trials and studies that impact child health worldwide.  It is home to the [b]CHOC Research Institute[/b], which conducts groundbreaking research in childhood diseases, clinical trials, and emerging therapies.

[b]Q: Why should I support a hospital headquartered in California?
A:[/b] CHOC offers highly specialized medical treatments for very ill children from around the world.  Their [b]CHOC Research Institute[/b] collaborates with international organizations to advance treatments for [b]rare diseases, childhood cancers, and neurological disorders[/b].  Their specialists [b]train international doctors and healthcare professionals[/b] in cutting-edge treatments and medical technologies. CHOC doctors and medical teams participate in [b]medical mission trips[/b], providing [b]free surgeries, medical supplies and medical care[/b] to children in underserved regions.

[b]Q:  How else can I support CHOC in its mission to save children's lives?
A: [/b] You can make a donation directly to CHOC [url=https://chocfoundation.donorsupport.co/page/FUNJGYWANMM?utm_medium=digital&utm_source=website&utm_campaign=digital_website_corporate_FrostGiant&utm_content=StormGate]at this link.[/url]

notes.title: Stormgate Hotfix - Jan 24, 2025
notes.content:
We've pushed out a small balance patch this morning, 

The recent round of economic balance changes have given Celestial a significantly stronger economy than intended.  As such, we’ll be bringing down some of the stats of Collection Arrays to match that of Vanguard Command Posts and Infernal Shrines.

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Collection Array cost increased from 450/0 to 550/0.
[*] Collection Array cost when morphing from a Morph Core increased from 350/0 to 450/0.
[*] Collection Array build time increased from 50 seconds to 90 seconds.
[*] Collection Array build time when morphing from a Morph Core increased from 20 seconds to 60 seconds.
[*] Prism build time increased from 45 seconds to 55 seconds.
[*] Morph Cores are no longer selectable through the "all army hotkey". They are now once again considered workers.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Arcship could no longer reliably rally Morph Cores.
[*] Fixed a bug where Sabers could hit air units with its weapon.
[/list]
